title: game/data/nodeTypes.json: the kinds of node on a run's map (roguelite track RL-6; logic/run-map.js)

name.description: what the player reads (the map's pins, the forecast)

mark.description: its marker on the run map: an outline of logic/run-marks.js RUN_MARK_TYPES (the type's id when left out)

engine.description: how it plays: scene (a walkable map) or menu (a story script or a shop sheet, RL-12)

weight.description: how often it fills a free row (rows rules.json run.map gives no role); 0 or left out: never
